description: Portrait of O'Keeffe sitting at the table in her dining room in Abiquiu looking towards her dinner guests: five young men sitting along the wall and looking at the camera with Tony Vaccaro, wearing a striped shirt, standing and pointing towards the camera in animated manner. Plates, utensils, a plate of bread, a bowl of apples, and a bottle of wine are visible on the table.
title: Georgia, the photographer and young Hispanic guests at dinner
